candidates.titulo: Google is launching a one-stop Gemini agent for your work tasks
candidates.resumen:
Google is launching a "universal" Gemini AI agent that can work across apps and devices in the background. The tool, announced as part of the Gemini at Work event on Thursday, will be available within the Gemini Enterprise app, allowing users to chat with the Gemini agent and assign it tasks from a single interface.

candidates.titulo: Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses
candidates.resumen: Google is turning Gemini into an AI agent that can plan, execute tasks, and work across business apps and systems. The agent can delegate work to subagents, use multiple AI models, and even gets its own workplace identity, complete with an email address.

candidates.titulo: Cal AI’s 19-year-old founder just raised $10M for his new AI startup
candidates.resumen: Zach Yadegari, the teen co-founder of popular Cal AI calorie tracking app, has launched a new personal AI agent startup that competes with Instinct, Muse, and Bee.

candidates.titulo: Anthropic changes usage policy to ban model abuse and election interference
candidates.resumen: Anthropic's updated usage policy explicitly prohibits users from repeatedly abusing Claude in extreme cases, though ordinary frustration and criticism are still allowed. The new rules also address election interference, deceptive campaigns, weapons software, and surveillance.

candidates.titulo: Natura’s $99 smart ring puts AI agents on your finger
candidates.resumen: Natura’s $99 Interface smart ring lets you summon AI agents with the press of a finger to complete tasks, capture thoughts, and control devices — while doubling as a health tracker.

candidates.titulo: Goodfire says its new ‘inside-out’ monitors catch rogue AI agents at a fraction of the cost
candidates.resumen: Goodfire just launched what it says is a cheaper way to keep AI agents in check: Instead of paying a second AI to read everything an agent does, its monitors peek inside the model while it works and only call in backup when something looks fishy.
